scheme_name: Scheme of Free Supply of Textbooks, Stationery, Uniforms and Footwears to Poor Children
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be studying in LKG to 12th Standard.
Applicant must be enrolled in a Government or Government‑aided Private School in Puducherry.
benefits_summary: Provides free textbooks, stationery, uniforms and footwear to eligible students from LKG to 12th standard, with class‑specific items such as laptops, umbrellas, and other supplies.
